1322-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1491-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

4695-7074-8089.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-2099-4908-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-4908-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4050-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2073-2921-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2921-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3821-6751-6844.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
3821-6751-6844.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1869-1916-4050.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Titan with haste.
The token Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Titan.
The nontoken Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Titan trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Titan token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
3967-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

662-1606-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Ley Weaver using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-2557-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3921-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

700-2736-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-2736-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-2736-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.
700-2736-3862.notes: You can repeat this combo for other opponents if mana allows, as you will regain control of Body of Knowledge once the opponent loses the game.

3967-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3967-6701--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2073-2707-5733-6504.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2073-2707-5733-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Notorious Throng onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Notorious Throng from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1809-2061-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1809-2061-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-1201-1358-1636.notablePrerequisites: Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
856-1201-1358-1636.description:
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing Witch's Oven to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1974-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-1974-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {5}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

2909-3009-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2909-3009-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Akroan Conscriptor.
Akroan Conscriptor triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Akroan Conscriptor and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Akroan Conscriptor's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

2404-2781-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2404-2781-4499.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.

803-914-1327-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
Cleaver Skaab does not have summoning sickness.
"Zombie" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-914-1327-2178.description:
Activate Cleaver Skaab by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Cleaver Skaab, untapping Cleaver Skaab.
Resolve the Cleaver Skaab ability from step 1, creating two token copies of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

337-776-1329-4671.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-4671.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Accorder's Shield to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Accorder's Shield.
Cast Accorder's Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
